items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Godines, that was the first tres player, the guitar player with Sexteto Habanero

ctx.x: So, when that thing started in Santiago de Cuba, he sent the regular army from Havana to Santiago de Cuba to stop the revolution, and Godines, that was the first tres player, the guitar player with Sexteto Habanero, and few other guys - they was so rhythmical - the economy was very bad in those days - so they went out there and they learned how to play the tres in Santiago de Cuba.
I see. The soldiers from Havana went there and they learned how to play .........
